div.div: 8 اُبْتُقِعَ لَوْنُهُ , with damm, i. q. اُنْتُقِعَ, and اُمْتُقِعَ; (the former in some copies of the K; the latter in others; and both in the TA;) i. e. His colour changed, (TA,) by reason of grief, or sorrow. (Har p. 244.) The last of these three verbs is the best. (Har ubi suprà.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
